originality.rationale: Central claim is the joint exact first-return-duration/maximum-cell-index transform, not the already classical Catalan time marginal or the geometric Galton–Watson marginal depth crossover. Ji–Ma 2023 gives the auxiliary chain and qualitative phase transition. Bruin–Todd arXiv:1104.5452 gives a tail-equivalent earlier map, recurrence and critical binomial matrix identities. García-Millán et al. 2015 explicitly covers the geometric-offspring generation survival crossover, which matches the present maximum-index marginal after shift. Full texts of these three primary publications were materially inspected; no joint finite-barrier time-depth transform was located. Equivalent probability-literature resolvents remain a genuine residual priority risk.
residual_risks: The auxiliary-map Markov tail is equivalent to the older Bruin–Todd chain; a general skip-free-walk first-passage resolvent or historical probability paper not identified here may already imply the same bivariate transform.

Classical Catalan time marginal and geometric Galton–Watson height marginal/scaling are not novel; originality and value rest on their exact joint finite-ceiling dependence and the explicit polynomial evaluation for this concrete dynamical setting.
Original Fibonacci bimodal dynamics is not semiconjugate to the auxiliary map, so no statistical transfer is asserted.

value.rationale: The full finite-ceiling transform determines all joint probabilities of transient length and deepest Markov cell for a natural absorbing excursion at the documented conservative/dissipative transition. The separate marginal theories, acknowledged as old, do not determine these correlations. Exact rational polynomial evaluation for arbitrary finite resolution and the two-parameter critical crossover provide concrete finite-observation content. This is neither an arbitrary slice nor merely a renamed classical univariate tail.
